candidate.title: PARE-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina schematic of PARE-Seq (parallel analysis of RNA ends, abbreviated PARE), specifically the poly(A)-selected, 5′-adapter/MmeI cDNA-tag library architecture illustrated from miRNA cleavage to PCR-amplified cDNA. The initial cleavage panel explains the biological substrate; the repeated leftmost capped-RNA icon names the assay and is not an alternative workflow. There is one retained library route with excluded upstream RNA and distal cDNA fractions. The matching collection page heading and caption confirm this target. Deep sequencing is described in text but lies beyond the drawn endpoint. This is a schematic-level extraction, not a claim that every PARE implementation uses an identical complete protocol.

method_scopes.rationale: The card title, matching collection heading/caption, and diagram label identify PARE-Seq / PARE as the same single target at this scope. All nine depicted transformation instances belong to this schematic: biological cleavage context, poly(A) selection, two distinct adapter ligations, reverse transcription, second-strand synthesis, MmeI digestion, purification, and PCR. No other assay, commercial kit, or additional application from a reference is declared as a target. Primary abstract evidence supports the RNA-end readout; detailed architecture is supported at diagram/catalogue level.
